assessments.reasoning: N3220 §6.2.4 paragraph 4 spans two pages. The first assigns thread storage duration when the declaration uses thread_local. The continuation establishes separate object identity for each thread and ties use of the name to the evaluating thread.

challenge.method: Could indirect access from another thread defeat the per-thread identity claim?
challenge.results: The continuation makes the result of that access implementation-defined. This qualification concerns the access result and preserves the separate identity of each thread’s object.

limitations: This records the rule in the working draft. It does not generalize a result when an object is accessed indirectly from another thread or assert behavior in the published standard.
This is the storage-duration and per-thread association rule in N3220. The indirect cross-thread case depends on the implementation under the draft.
